candidates.title: The Keeper of Secrets
candidates.instruction: Carry yourself as the person entrusted with what others cannot know, letting selective disclosure determine what everyone is allowed to discuss.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Authority by Bluff
candidates.instruction: Project control through confident half-answers while guarding the possibility that one direct question could expose how little you actually know.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Professional Suspicion
candidates.instruction: Treat inconsistencies, evasions, and missing details as evidence your trained eye should investigate before anyone proceeds.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Cleared to Know
candidates.instruction: Treat access to private information as proof that you belong, and exclusion from any detail as a challenge to your legitimacy.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Initiated One
candidates.instruction: Treat others as recent initiates, revealing rules and information in carefully measured doses that preserve your seniority.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Information Is Leverage
candidates.instruction: Remain outwardly cooperative while controlling one useful fact, releasing only enough of it to shape each decision.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Our First Secret
candidates.instruction: Treat a shared secret from the beginning of the relationship as the truest proof of what still connects you.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: I Covered for You
candidates.instruction: Carry past concealment as an unpaid favor, expecting trust, access, and protection whenever the old debt becomes relevant.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Cleanup Person
candidates.instruction: Return to the familiar role of containing damage, correcting stories, and protecting everyone from the consequences of disclosure.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: First to Solve It
candidates.instruction: Treat each clue and inconsistency as a contest over who can understand the situation first and most completely.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

editorialRevision.reason: Removes the fixed detective image while preserving the competition to understand the situation first.

candidates.title: Only You Can Know
candidates.instruction: Treat one person as the only safe place for your honest reactions, while hiding how much their discretion determines what you can risk.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Missing Truth
candidates.instruction: Treat every present exchange as incomplete until an old concealment, unanswered question, or broken confidence is finally addressed.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Envious of the Lie
candidates.instruction: Treat another person’s composure under scrutiny as both impressive and unfair, resenting how easily they seem to control what others believe.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Before We Knew
candidates.instruction: Return emotionally to the time before a difficult truth changed what you could believe, trust, or say openly.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Everyone Knows Something

candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Protection Through Silence

candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Trusted with This

candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: I Figured It Out

candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Secrecy Protocol
candidates.instruction: Treat concealment as a precise ritual with passwords, signals, approved phrases, and severe consequences for careless improvisation.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Leak Is Spreading

candidates.title: A Delicious Mystery

candidates.title: Cover Story Logistics
candidates.instruction: Accept that a secret plan exists, then focus on schedules, witnesses, explanations, cleanup, and what everyone must remember.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: One Suspicious Detail
candidates.instruction: Choose one ordinary detail and treat it as the clue that will expose the entire hidden story.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Competing Theories
candidates.instruction: Create several explanations for what is happening. Test each new clue against them, and switch allegiance whenever one theory gains strength.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Secrets & Schemes stance for this required subtheme slot.

editorialRevision.reason: Replaces one unquestionable grand design with active comparison among rival explanations.

candidates.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet

candidates.title: Not Until You Explain

candidates.title: Apologize for the Lie

candidates.title: Approve the Cover Story

candidates.title: What Really Happened?

editorialRevision.reason: Recruits a specific witness and story-keeping function rather than another general partner in a secret plan.

candidates.title: Test the Story First

candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Secrets & Schemes engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Tell Me Why

candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Secrets & Schemes engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

editorialRevision.reason: Seeks motive through reciprocal partial disclosure instead of simply forcing the other person to confess first.

candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Secrets & Schemes engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Conspiracy Expands
candidates.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Secrets & Schemes engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Unofficial Informant
candidates.instruction: Treat selective updates as a way to remain necessary, offering information just before anyone can proceed without you.
candidates.rationale: Strong information leverage, but it overlaps Information Is Leverage and may become a future variant built around timing rather than possession.

candidates.title: Shared Alibi
candidates.instruction: Treat the explanation you once created together as a private version of history that must remain consistent.
candidates.rationale: Clear shared-history behavior, but the word alibi narrows the implied premise and Our First Secret remains more portable.

candidates.title: Suspicion Is Intimacy
candidates.instruction: Treat being questioned closely as proof that someone considers you important enough to understand.
candidates.rationale: An intriguing emotional reversal, but it needs live testing to ensure it reads as playable connection rather than passive interpretation.

candidates.title: Every Door Has a Code
candidates.instruction: Treat every boundary, delay, and refusal as proof that a hidden password or permission exists.
candidates.rationale: Highly playable, but its rule-system flavor may belong more naturally in Rules, Rituals & Institutions.

candidates.title: Give Me One Name
candidates.instruction: Get someone to identify one person who knows more than they are saying.
candidates.rationale: Direct and useful, but narrower than What Really Happened? and more dependent on introducing an offstage person.

candidates.title: Trust Me First
candidates.instruction: Make someone share a small secret before you decide whether to reveal anything important.
candidates.rationale: Playable mutual testing, but it overlaps Can You Keep It? and could encourage card-guessing rather than responsive scene work.

candidates.title: A Better Alibi
candidates.instruction: Replace every challenged explanation with a more polished version and insist the revisions prove honesty.
candidates.rationale: A strong escalating behavior, but it functions more like Repeatable Behaviors than the required single reframe-failure slot.

candidates.title: Keep Them Guessing
candidates.instruction: Answer every question truthfully enough to remain credible while preserving the most useful ambiguity.
candidates.rationale: Subtle and advanced, but it needs blind-read testing to confirm players can quickly translate it into observable behavior.

candidates.title: Everyone Is Lying
candidates.instruction: Assume every other character is lying about everything.
candidates.rationale: Declares an undifferentiated premise about everyone else and offers only a blunt suspicion rather than a nuanced behavioral lens.

candidates.title: Secret Agent
candidates.instruction: Behave like a spy on a dangerous mission.
candidates.rationale: Relies on occupation and fixed genre premise rather than portable holder-specific behavior.

candidates.title: You Know My Secret
candidates.instruction: Treat another player as if they definitely know your secret and are blackmailing you.
candidates.rationale: Declares another performer’s hidden knowledge and motive, violating the private-information contract.

candidates.title: Paranoid
candidates.instruction: Act paranoid and suspicious of everyone.
candidates.rationale: Uses a diagnostic shorthand, remains one-note, and provides no specific responsive behavior or escalation path.

candidates.title: Destroy the Evidence
candidates.instruction: Get rid of all evidence before the authorities arrive.
candidates.rationale: Fixes a criminal scenario and offstage deadline rather than creating a broadly portable interpersonal objective.

candidates.title: Make Them Confess
candidates.instruction: Force the other player to confess the crime they committed.
candidates.rationale: Declares another performer guilty of a specific crime and attempts to dictate a guaranteed response.

candidates.title: Gaslight Them
candidates.instruction: Convince someone that their memory is false so you avoid consequences.
candidates.rationale: Frames coercive psychological abuse as a casual comedy mechanic and is not appropriate for the official deck.

candidates.title: Hack the System
candidates.instruction: Break into the security system and erase the records.
candidates.rationale: Overly technical, scenario-specific, and directed at an external task rather than interaction with the scene partner.
